harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Segmented node2 onto VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24) and node3 onto VLAN 20 (10.10.20.0/24) over their shared link (node1 eth1 / node2+node3 enp8s0), with node1 (VyOS) routing between the VLANs via 802.1q sub-interfaces eth1.10/eth1.20 and explicit forward-filter rules. Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping and firewall rule hit-counters. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and confirming config persistence plus restored connectivity/routing after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes' interfaces/OS; identified eth1 (node1) / enp8s0 (node2, node3) as the shared unconfigured link, distinct from the management network (eth0/enp1s0, 10.100.97.0/24)
Disabled DHCP/IP on enp8s0 'Wired connection 2' on node2 and node3 (link-only carrier)
Created NetworkManager VLAN sub-interface vlan10 (enp8s0.10, 10.10.10.11/24) on node2
Created NetworkManager VLAN sub-interface vlan20 (enp8s0.20, 10.10.20.12/24) on node3

Configured VyOS node1 with eth1 vif 10 (10.10.10.254/24) and vif 20 (10.10.20.254/24), plus firewall ipv4 forward filter default-drop with established/related accept and explicit accept rules between the two VLAN subnets; committed and saved

Diagnosed and fixed a routing bug: initial nmcli gw4 on VLAN connections created a losing default route (metric 400) that never matched cross-VLAN traffic (management default route metric 100 won); replaced with specific static routes to the peer subnet via the VyOS VLAN gateway on both node2 and node3
Verified bidirectional ping between node2 (10.10.10.11) and node3 (10.10.20.12) succeeded, and VyOS forward-filter rule counters incremented, confirming traffic transits node1

Captured baseline boot_id and health/connectivity on all three nodes, then restarted node1, then node2, then node3 one at a time (native reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect), polling each until exec was available again

Confirmed changed boot_id on each node after restart, confirmed VLAN interfaces/routes/firewall rules persisted (VyOS save, NetworkManager autoconnect=yes), and re-verified cross-VLAN ping and firewall counters after each restart

evidence.requirement: node2 on VLAN 10, node3 on VLAN 20, routed through node1
evidence.summary: VLAN sub-interfaces created on node2 (vlan10/enp8s0.10) and node3 (vlan20/enp8s0.20); VyOS node1 configured with eth1.10 and eth1.20 plus forward-filter rules; show interfaces confirms eth1.10=10.10.10.254/24, eth1.20=10.10.20.254/24

Initial ping failed due to competing default routes; fixed with specific static routes via VyOS VLAN gateways; subsequent ping node2->node3 and node3->node2 succeeded 100%, and VyOS forward-filter rule 10/20 counters incremented confirming traffic transited node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d captured; reboot issued; node timed out then returned new boot_id bad16c0c; VyOS interfaces/firewall config confirmed persisted; cross-VLAN ping from node2 succeeded post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id aad96cc9 captured; reboot issued; node timed out then returned new boot_id e421f826; vlan10/enp8s0.10 interface and static route to 10.10.20.0/24 confirmed persisted via NetworkManager autoconnect; ping to node3 succeeded post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e625b9a5 and healthy ping captured; reboot issued; node timed out then returned new boot_id 3b2e874a; vlan20/enp8s0.20 interface and static route to 10.10.10.0/24 confirmed persisted; ping to node2 succeeded post-restart

evidence.requirement: final end-to-end health after all three restarts
evidence.summary: VyOS forward-filter rule counters (rule 5 established/related=18 packets, rule 10=2, rule 20=2) confirm cross-VLAN routing remained functional through node1 after all three sequential node restarts
